### Bulk Edit Products and Prices

Request body (required) (application/json) BulkEditRequestDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- products* object[] - Array of products to update. Note: The total count includes all prices within each product.
  - _id* string (e.g. "64a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456") - Product ID
  - name string (e.g. "Premium Product") - Product name
  - description string (e.g. "A high-quality premium product with excellent features and durability") - Product description
  - image string (e.g. "https://example.com/product-image.jpg") - Product image
  - availableInStore boolean - Product availability in store
  - prices object[] - Array of price variants for the product
    - _id* string (e.g. "64a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456") - Price ID
    - name string (e.g. "Standard Plan") - Price name
    - amount number (e.g. 99.99) - Price amount
    - currency string (e.g. "USD") - Price currency
    - compareAtPrice number (e.g. 129.99) - Compare at price
    - availableQuantity number (e.g. 100) - Available quantity
    - trackInventory boolean - Track inventory
    - allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Allow out of stock purchases
    - sku string (e.g. "SKU-001") - SKU
    - trialPeriod number (e.g. 7) - Trial period in days
    - totalCycles number (e.g. 12) - Total billing cycles
    - setupFee number (e.g. 25) - Setup fee
    - shippingOptions object - Shipping options
      - weight object - Weight options of the product
        - value* number (e.g. 10) - Actual weight of the product
        - unit* string (enum: kg | lb | g | oz; e.g. "kg") - Weight unit of the product
      - dimensions object - Dimensions of the product
        - height* number (e.g. 10) - Height of the price
        - width* number (e.g. 10) - Width of the price
        - length* number (e.g. 10) - Length of the price
        - unit* string (enum: cm | in | m; e.g. "cm") - Unit of the price dimensions
    - recurring object - Recurring details
      - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year; e.g. "day") - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
      - intervalCount* number (e.g. 1) - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
  - collectionIds string[] (e.g. ["64a1b2c3d4e5f67890123458","64a1b2c3d4e5f67890123459"]) - Collection IDs
  - isLabelEnabled boolean - Enable product label
  - isTaxesEnabled boolean - Enable taxes
  - seo object - SEO metadata for the product
    - title string (e.g. "Best Product - Buy Now") - SEO title
    - description string (e.g. "This is the best product you can buy online with amazing features and great value") - SEO description
  - slug string (e.g. "premium-product") - Product URL slug
  - automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "64a1b2c3d4e5f67890123460") - Automatic tax category ID
  - taxInclusive boolean - Tax inclusive pricing
  - taxes object[] - Product taxes
  - medias object[] - Product media
  - label object - Product label

Response 201 (Products and prices updated successfully) application/json:
- message* string - Success message
- status* boolean - Operation status
- updatedCount* number - Number of products updated

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create Product
POST /products/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/create-product | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/create-product.md

The "Create Product" API allows adding a new product to the system. Use this endpoint to create a product with the specified details. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateProductDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Awesome Product") - The name of the product.
- locationId* string (e.g. "3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6") - The unique identifier for the location.
- description string (e.g. "Product description goes here.") - A brief description of the product.
- productType* string (enum: DIGITAL | PHYSICAL | SERVICE | PHYSICAL/DIGITAL)
- image string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/65af8d5df88bdb4b1022ee90.png") - The URL for the product image.
- statementDescriptor string (e.g. "abcde") - The statement descriptor for the product.
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- medias object[] - An array of medias for the product.
  - id* string (e.g. "fzrgusiuu0m") - The unique identifier for the media.
  - title string (e.g. "1dd7dcd0-e71d-4cf7-a06b-6d47723d6a29.png") - The title of the media file.
  - url* string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/sample.png") - The URL where the media file is stored.
  - type* string (enum: image | video; e.g. "image") - The type of the media file (e.g., image, video will be supporting soon).
  - isFeatured boolean - Indicates whether the media is featured.
  - priceIds any[][] (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Mongo ObjectIds of the prices for which the media is assigned
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.
  - id* string (e.g. "38s63qmxfr4") - A unique identifier for the variant.
  - name* string (e.g. "Size") - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string (e.g. "h4z7u0im2q8") - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string (e.g. "XL") - The name of the option.
- collectionIds string[] (e.g. ["65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5","65d71377c326ea78e1c47d34"]) - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - Are there any taxes attached to the product. If this is true, taxes array cannot be empty.
- taxes string[] (e.g. ["654492a4e6bef380114de15a"]) - List of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If taxes are passed, isTaxesEnabled should be true.
- automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5") - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.
- isLabelEnabled boolean (default: false) - Is the product label enabled. If this is true, label object cannot be empty.
- label object - Details for Product Label
  - title* string (e.g. "Featured") - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string (e.g. "2024-06-26T05:43:35.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string (e.g. "2024-06-30T05:43:39.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string (e.g. "awesome-product") - The slug using which the product navigation will be handled
- seo object - SEO data for the product that will be displayed in the preview
  - title string (e.g. "Best Product - Buy Now") - SEO title
  - description string (e.g. "This is the best product you can buy online with amazing features and great value") - SEO description
- taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - Whether the taxes should be included in the purchase price

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
- description string - product description
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.
  - id* string - A unique identifier for the variant.
  - name* string - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string - The name of the option.
- locationId* string - The unique identifier for the location.
- name* string - The name of the product.
- productType* string - The type of the product (e.g., PHYSICAL).
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the product.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the product.
- statementDescriptor string - The statement descriptor for the product.
- image string - The URL for the product image.
- collectionIds string[] - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - The field indicates whether taxes are enabled for the product or not.
- taxes string[] - An array of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If the expand query includes tax, the taxes will be of type `ProductTaxDto`. Please refer to the `ProductTaxDto` for additional details.
- automaticTaxCategoryId string - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.
- label object - The Product label details
  - title* string - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string - The slug of the product by which the product will be navigated

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-price-by-id-for-product | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-price-by-id-for-product.md

The "Update Price by ID for a Product" API allows modifying information for a specific price associated with a particular product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to update details for a single price based on the provided price ID and product ID.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products/prices.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products/prices.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the product that needs to be used
- priceId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the price that needs to be returned

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdatePriceDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Price Name") - The name of the price.
- type* string (enum: one_time | recurring; e.g. "one_time") - The type of the price.
- currency* string (e.g. "USD") - The currency of the price.
- amount* number (e.g. 99.99) - The amount of the price. ( min: 0 )
- recurring object - The recurring details of the price (if type is recurring).
  - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year; e.g. "day") - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
  - intervalCount* number (e.g. 1) - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
- description string - A brief description of the price.
- membershipOffers object[] - An array of membership offers associated with the price.
  - label* string (e.g. "top_50") - Membership offer label
  - value* string (e.g. "50") - Membership offer label
  - _id* string (e.g. "655b33aa2209e60b6adb87a7") - The unique identifier for the membership offer.
- trialPeriod number (e.g. 7) - The trial period duration in days (if applicable).
- totalCycles number (e.g. 12) - The total number of billing cycles for the price. ( min: 1 )
- setupFee number (e.g. 10.99) - The setup fee for the price.
- variantOptionIds string[] (e.g. ["option_id_1","option_id_2"]) - An array of variant option IDs associated with the price.
- compareAtPrice number (e.g. 19.99) - The compare at price for the price.
- locationId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the location associated with the price.
- userId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the user who created the price.
- meta object - Additional metadata associated with the price.
  - source* string (enum: stripe | woocommerce | shopify; e.g. "stripe") - The source of the price.
  - sourceId string (e.g. "123") - The id of the source of the price from where it is imported
  - stripePriceId* string (e.g. "price_123") - The Stripe price ID associated with the price.
  - internalSource* string (enum: agency_plan | funnel | membership | communities | gokollab | calendar; e.g. "agency_plan") - The internal source of the price.
- trackInventory boolean - Need to track inventory stock quantity
- availableQuantity number (e.g. 5) - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock
- sku string (e.g. "sku_123") - The unique identifier of the SKU associated with the price
- shippingOptions object - Shipping options of the Price
  - weight object - Weight options of the product
    - value* number (e.g. 10) - Actual weight of the product
    - unit* string (enum: kg | lb | g | oz; e.g. "kg") - Weight unit of the product
  - dimensions object - Dimensions of the product
    - height* number (e.g. 10) - Height of the price
    - width* number (e.g. 10) - Width of the price
    - length* number (e.g. 10) - Length of the price
    - unit* string (enum: cm | in | m; e.g. "cm") - Unit of the price dimensions
- isDigitalProduct boolean - Is the product a digital product
- digitalDelivery string[] - Digital delivery options

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the price.
- membershipOffers object[] - An array of membership offers associated with the price.
  - label* string - Membership offer label
  - value* string - Membership offer label
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the membership offer.
- variantOptionIds string[] - An array of variant option IDs associated with the price.
- locationId string - The unique identifier for the location.
- product string - The unique identifier for the associated product.
- userId string - The unique identifier for the user.
- name* string - The name of the price.
- type* string (enum: one_time | recurring) - The type of the price (e.g., one_time).
- currency* string - The currency code for the price.
- amount* number - The amount of the price.
- recurring object - The recurring details of the price (if type is recurring).
  - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year) - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
  - intervalCount* number - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
- createdAt string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the price.
- updatedAt string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the price.
- compareAtPrice number - The compare-at price for comparison purposes.
- trackInventory boolean - Indicates whether inventory tracking is enabled.
- availableQuantity number - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Product by ID
PUT /products/{productId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/{productId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-by-id.md

The "Update Product by ID" API allows modifying information for a specific product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to update details for a single product based on the provided product ID.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID or the slug of the product that needs to be returned

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateProductDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Awesome Product") - The name of the product.
- locationId* string (e.g. "3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6") - The unique identifier for the location.
- description string (e.g. "Product description goes here.") - A brief description of the product.
- productType* string (enum: DIGITAL | PHYSICAL | SERVICE | PHYSICAL/DIGITAL)
- image string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/65af8d5df88bdb4b1022ee90.png") - The URL for the product image.
- statementDescriptor string (e.g. "abcde") - The statement descriptor for the product.
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- medias object[] - An array of medias for the product.
  - id* string (e.g. "fzrgusiuu0m") - The unique identifier for the media.
  - title string (e.g. "1dd7dcd0-e71d-4cf7-a06b-6d47723d6a29.png") - The title of the media file.
  - url* string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/sample.png") - The URL where the media file is stored.
  - type* string (enum: image | video; e.g. "image") - The type of the media file (e.g., image, video will be supporting soon).
  - isFeatured boolean - Indicates whether the media is featured.
  - priceIds any[][] (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Mongo ObjectIds of the prices for which the media is assigned
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.
  - id* string (e.g. "38s63qmxfr4") - A unique identifier for the variant.
  - name* string (e.g. "Size") - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string (e.g. "h4z7u0im2q8") - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string (e.g. "XL") - The name of the option.
- collectionIds string[] (e.g. ["65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5","65d71377c326ea78e1c47d34"]) - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - Are there any taxes attached to the product. If this is true, taxes array cannot be empty.
- taxes string[] (e.g. ["654492a4e6bef380114de15a"]) - List of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If taxes are passed, isTaxesEnabled should be true.
- automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5") - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.
- isLabelEnabled boolean (default: false) - Is the product label enabled. If this is true, label object cannot be empty.
- label object - Details for Product Label
  - title* string (e.g. "Featured") - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string (e.g. "2024-06-26T05:43:35.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string (e.g. "2024-06-30T05:43:39.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string (e.g. "awesome-product") - The slug using which the product navigation will be handled
- seo object - SEO data for the product that will be displayed in the preview
  - title string (e.g. "Best Product - Buy Now") - SEO title
  - description string (e.g. "This is the best product you can buy online with amazing features and great value") - SEO description
- taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - Whether the taxes should be included in the purchase price
- prices string[] - The prices of the product

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the product.
- description string - product description
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.
  - id* string - A unique identifier for the variant.
  - name* string - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string - The name of the option.
- locationId* string - The unique identifier for the location.
- name* string - The name of the product.
- productType* string - The type of the product (e.g., PHYSICAL).
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the product.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the product.
- statementDescriptor string - The statement descriptor for the product.
- image string - The URL for the product image.
- collectionIds string[] - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - The field indicates whether taxes are enabled for the product or not.
- taxes string[] - An array of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If the expand query includes tax, the taxes will be of type `ProductTaxDto`. Please refer to the `ProductTaxDto` for additional details.
- automaticTaxCategoryId string - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.
- label object - The Product label details
  - title* string - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string - The slug of the product by which the product will be navigated

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Product Collection
PUT /products/collections/{collectionId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/collections/{collectionId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-collection | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-collection.md

Update a specific product collection with Id :collectionId

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products/collection.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- collectionId* string (e.g. "65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5") - MongoId of the collection

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateProductCollectionsDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "LOCATION") - The type of alt. For now it is only LOCATION
- name string (e.g. "Best Sellers") - Name of the Product Collection
- slug string (e.g. "best-sellers") - Slug of the Product Collection which helps in navigation
- image string (e.g. "http://example.com/watermark.png") - The URL of the image that is going to be displayed as the collection Thumbnail
- seo object - The metadata information which will be displayed in SEO previews
  - title string (e.g. "Best Sellers") - The title which will be displayed as an SEO format
  - description string (e.g. "Collections where all the best products are available") - The description which would be displayed in preview purposes

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Product Reviews
PUT /products/reviews/{reviewId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/reviews/{reviewId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-review | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-product-review.md

Update status, reply, etc of a particular review

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- reviewId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Review Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateProductReviewDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- productId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Product Id
- status* string (e.g. "approved") - Status of the review
- reply object[] - Reply of the review
  - headline* string (minLength: 0; maxLength: 200; e.g. "Amazing product with great quality") - Headline of the Review
  - comment* string (minLength: 0; maxLength: 5000; e.g. "This product exceeded my expectations in terms of quality and performance. Highly recommended!") - Detailed Review of the product
  - user* object - User who is giving the review/reply
    - name* string (minLength: 1; maxLength: 100; e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the customer
    - email* string (e.g. "example@example.com") - Email of the customer
    - phone string (e.g. "+1-555-555-5555") - Phone no of the customer
    - isCustomer boolean - Is the person an admin or customer
- rating number (e.g. "4.5") - Rating of the product
- headline string (e.g. "Amazing product with great quality") - Headline of the Review
- detail string (e.g. "The product is for sure a must and recommended buy") - Detailed Review of the product

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Action to include/exclude the product in store
POST /products/store/{storeId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/store/{storeId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-store-status | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/update-store-status.md

API to update the status of products in a particular store

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- storeId* string (e.g. "3SwdhCu3svxI8AKsPJt6") - Products related to the store

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateProductStoreDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- action* string (enum: include | exclude; e.g. "include") - Action to include or exclude the product from the store
- productIds* string[] (e.g. ["productId1","productId2"]) - Array of product IDs

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- status* boolean - Status of api action
- message string - Success message

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
